column1: # What app code may not write by hand: the design system (`crate::ui`) has the token or component for it, or a
# narrower redraw exists. Counted by tools/ui_lint.py (cargo test, and the edit hooks in .claude/settings.json).
# One rule a line: name<TAB>regex<TAB>scope<TAB>what to do instead. Scope is `any`, `impl:Type` to count only
# inside `impl Type` blocks, `file` for a file-wide limit (its second column is the limit), `chain` for an element's
# shape, its builder chain (second column: clauses, see tools/ui_chains.py), `render` / `ui-thread` for a regex matched only on the render path / the UI
# thread (tools/ui_perf.py), `hot-notify` / `waffle-notify` / `growth` for those checks (second column unused), `source` for a regex
# matched on the line as written, strings included, or `fn` for a function named like a
# component (second column: a regex on its name) that returns an element built without any ui:: component.
# An allow for a `chain` or `fn` rule names the ui:: item it considered (`lint-allow(custom-button): ui::Toggle has
# no cycling value`); every allow is listed in src/ui/ONE_OFFS.md, and two allowed copies of one element fail. Strings and comments never count. A line (or the line above it) holding
# `lint-allow(<rule>): <reason>` in a comment is exempt from that rule. The design system itself (src/ui.rs,
# src/ui/, palette, motion, icons) is exempt; it's where these values live.

column4: Spacing: gpui's scale (gap_2, p_1p5, mt_3 … see ui/tokens.rs). Sizes: a ui token (TEXT_*, ICON_*, AVATAR_*, RADIUS_*, HAIRLINE) or a named const.
Colour: a palette:: role (palette::text, palette::surface(Level::..), palette::accent …).
Weight: a named FontWeight (NORMAL, MEDIUM, SEMIBOLD, BOLD).
Floating surface: ui::Popover::floating / ui::Popover::floating_at. They occlude, so nothing under them takes the pointer.
Tooltip: ui::Tooltip::new(text).build(window, cx), the design's tooltip.

App-wide redraw: notifying Waffle re-renders every column. Notify only when what's drawn changed; for state one column draws use self.redraw(Column::X, cx); fast-changing state gets its own entity (CLAUDE.md, Rendering).

Split it: move a self-contained part (a view, a section, a group of helpers) into its own module, and put new code in a new file rather than a long one. Counts lines of code: blank lines, comments and #[cfg(test)] modules don't count. A file that was already longer when the rule came in may only shrink.

Clickable: ui::Button (an icon button is size Icon), ui::round_button, ui::Toggle, ui::DropdownMenuItem, ui::settings_choice or ui::pressable. Missing a look? Give ui::Button a variant, size or scope (src/ui/button.rs), as shadcn's cva does, and use it.
Floating or raised surface: ui::PopoverContent, ui::Popover, ui::Sonner, ui::Dialog or ui::Card. Missing a level, radius or inset? Add it as an option there.
Divider: ui::Separator (`.orientation`, `.label`, `.inset`).
Label: ui::Badge (`.variant`, `Badge::count`, `Badge::dot`), ui::pill or ui::role_chip; add a variant there if none fits.
A mark on a face's or control's corner: ui::badged with a Spot (it places the mark for the face's shape and cuts its ring). Missing a host shape or ring style? Add it to src/ui/face.rs.
Row: ui::row() (centred, shrinks: min_w_0), then gap_* between children.
Column: ui::col() (shrinks: min_w_0, min_h_0), then gap_* between children.
One-line text: ui::line(text), or ui::truncating(key, text) when the cut text should show in a tooltip.

Space between siblings is the parent's gap (gap_*, gap_x_*, gap_y_*) on a ui::row / ui::col / grid; space inside is the parent's padding; pushing to the end is flex_1 or justify_between. Margins stay near 0: an optical nudge carries lint-allow(raw-margin) with why.

A function named like a component (a split, a joined pair of controls is ui::ButtonGroup) builds it from the design system: wrap the ui:: component (a domain wrapper is fine), or add the component to src/ui/ first (tools/ui_find.py searches what exists).

A scrolling list that builds every row: list/uniform_list with a ListState draw only the rows on screen (CLAUDE.md, Rendering). A list that stays small carries lint-allow(unvirtualized-list) saying how big it can get ("a server's roles, a few dozen at most"), so whoever grows it knows to virtualize it.

Work on the render path runs on every redraw: sort, parse, read files or build entities and subscriptions when their inputs change and keep the result in state (CLAUDE.md, Rendering). cx.new / cx.subscribe in render make a new entity or subscription every frame. A small bounded case carries lint-allow(render-work) saying how small.
Blocking I/O on the UI thread stalls every frame: move it into cx.background_spawn (or the background executor) and send the result back.

A notify in a pointer-move, hover or scroll handler, or a timer loop, runs dozens of times a second (while a list scrolls, every row passes under a still pointer and fires its hover): compare the new value with the old and notify only when what's drawn changed; a fast source gets its own entity (CLAUDE.md, Rendering).

A function handed Waffle (Entity, WeakEntity or Context<Waffle>) that notifies it redraws every column, as global-notify does inside impl Waffle: check the old value first and call this.redraw(Column::X, cx) for state one column draws (CLAUDE.md, Rendering).
An app-wide redraw past every cache: window.refresh() re-renders every view, cached columns included. Notify the view whose drawing changed (cx.notify() on its entity, or self.redraw(Column::X, cx)).

A scan of every server, channel or DM on the render path runs on every redraw, once per row in a list: look it up through a map keyed by id, or derive it when its inputs change and keep it in state (CLAUDE.md, Rendering).
A repeating animation redraws every frame while it's on screen: run it only while its state holds (speaking, loading) and say when it stops in lint-allow(endless-animation).

A detached task outlives its view: keep the Task in the view so dropping the view cancels it (CLAUDE.md, Idiomatic Rust). Detach only a task that ends itself, and say how in lint-allow(detached-task); hold a WeakEntity, never an Entity, in it.

A collection field that the app grows and never shrinks holds memory for the whole session: cap it (evict, truncate, an LRU), or clear it when what it's for goes away. A bound that holds by nature carries lint-allow(unbounded-growth) saying it ("one per joined server").
A Discord CDN image without ?size= downloads and decodes the full image (a 4096px avatar is 64 MB decoded): ask for the size it's drawn at, rounded up to a power of two.
Every view counts its renders for the opt-in check (WAFFLE_PERF=1, make perf): start render with crate::perf::probe("ViewName").

A title-line header (a WindowControlArea::Drag) shares the window's top with Windows' caption buttons (top right, window_controls::WIDTH x HEADER_HEIGHT) and macOS's traffic lights (top left): end it with self.caption_clearance(reaches_right_edge), start it past layout::traffic_lights_overhang, or build it on panel_frame. Derive reaches_right_edge from the same fact that places the header, never a nearby flag. A strip that only drags, under nothing interactive, carries lint-allow(titlebar-clearance) saying so. Cases: design/titlebar-overlaps.html.
A floating surface keeps under the window's title line: snap_to_window_with_margin(ui::FLOAT_EDGES), or ui::Popover::floating / ui::Popover::floating_at, which use it.
